sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Seasonal change: this quest cannot be obtained.

Professional Fitness - Part 1 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "So, you ready to prove your professional chops? I'm not going to go too hard on you, don't sweat it. For starters, just step onto the Arena. Yeah, that's all, no extra tasks. Just soak in the atmosphere!"

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Play a match in CheckPoint or Last Hero mode in Arena

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +1,800 EXP
- Ref Rep +0.01
- 10 GP coins
  - 10 GP coins with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 12 GP coins with Intelligence Center Level 2
"Yeah, yeah, I saw you in action. You're not exactly grabbing the stars yet, but at least there's something to work with."
